equations.label: Zou-He velocity BC, top wall (lid) u_w=(U,0); unknowns f4 (S), f7 (SW), f8 (SE); numbering 1E 2N 3W 4S 5NE 6NW 7SW 8SE
equations.location: non-equilibrium bounce-back principle (paper writes the bottom/inlet versions); rotated to the lid here and checked numerically to reproduce rho and rho*u to round-off; eq. numbers unverified

assumptions: Low Mach number: Ma = U/c_s << 1 (compressibility error O(Ma^2)); typical lid U <= 0.1 lattice units
Isothermal, weakly compressible; recovers incompressible NS only in the limit Ma->0
Uniform lattice, dx=dt=1 in lattice units
Steady results require convergence (residual) rather than fixed step counts
methods.discretization: Lattice units: N cells across the reference length, lid speed U_lb (e.g. 0.1), nu_lb = U_lb N / Re, tau = 3 nu_lb + 1/2. One step = local BGK collision then streaming to the 8 neighbours. Physical time per step: dt_phys = (U_lb/U_phys) (L/N). Cavity: halfway bounce-back on the 3 stationary walls, lid by Zou-He (or moving-wall bounce-back; corner nodes need a convention). Cylinder: staircase bounce-back on cells inside the circle (1st order in geometry) or interpolated bounce-back; parabolic Zou-He inflow, pressure (density) Zou-He or zero-gradient outflow. Taylor-Green: fully periodic, initialise f = f^eq(rho0, u0) (optionally with rho from the analytic pressure, rho = rho0 + p/c_s^2).
boundary_conditions: no-slip: halfway bounce-back (wall half a cell outside the last fluid node)
moving lid: Zou-He velocity BC or bounce-back with momentum correction
inflow: Zou-He velocity BC with prescribed profile
outflow: Zou-He pressure BC (rho = rho0) or extrapolation
methods.stability: tau > 1/2 (positive viscosity); in practice tau >~ 0.51-0.55 with BGK, otherwise high-Re runs blow up. Keep Ma = U_lb/c_s < ~0.3 (U_lb < ~0.17), preferably U_lb <= 0.1 for accuracy. Since Re = U_lb N/nu_lb, tau = 1/2 + 3 U_lb N/Re: at Re=1000, U_lb=0.1, N=128 gives tau=0.538 and N=256 gives 0.577 (both workable with BGK); at Re=100 tau is comfortably large. hou1995 reports explicit stable parameter ranges (abstract; values not read).
failure_modes: tau -> 1/2: under-resolved, checkerboard oscillations then NaN
Large U_lb: compressibility error, density variations > 1%
Lid corners: singular velocity; Zou-He corner nodes ill-defined, cause local mass leakage
Staircase cylinder: effective diameter uncertain -> cD bias of a few % at 10-20 cells/D
Mass drift with Zou-He/open boundaries (closed cavity with bounce-back should conserve mass to round-off)

assumptions: Simply connected domain (psi = const = 0 on all cavity walls); multiply-connected domains (cylinder) need an extra condition for psi on the body
Steady solutions obtained by pseudo-time marching or Newton/multigrid (Ghia: coupled strongly implicit multigrid; Erturk: implicit, 601^2)
methods.discretization: Uniform grid h=1/N on unit square. Explicit option: FTCS for omega with central (or upwind) convection, then solve Poisson for psi (SOR / Jacobi / multigrid / FFT-sine), update u, v by central differences, set wall omega by Thom. Ghia used 129x129 (Re<=3200) and 257x257 (higher Re) per common citation (unverified).
boundary_conditions: omega on walls from Thom's formula (lid includes -2U/h term)
Taylor-Green: periodic psi, omega (psi = -(U0/k) cos(kx)cos(ky) F(t) for the reference field)
methods.stability: Explicit FTCS: diffusion number nu dt/h^2 <= 1/4 (2-D) and convective CFL (|u|+|v|) dt/h <= 1; cell Peclet |u| h Re <= 2 for central convection without upwinding. Standard von Neumann results; not traced to a cited equation here.
failure_modes: Central differencing at high cell Reynolds -> wiggles; first-order upwind adds false diffusion (Re=1000 vortex weakened)
Poisson solve not converged per step -> psi/omega inconsistency and slow drift
Lid-corner singularity: omega unbounded at corners; affects local accuracy only
Wrong sign in Thom formula -> vortex rotating the wrong way

assumptions: Visual plausibility prioritised over accuracy (stam2003 abstract: stability and speed over physical accuracy)
Collocated grid with (N+2)^2 cells incl. ghost layer; unit domain h=1/N
methods.discretization: Operator splitting per step: add forces -> diffuse (implicit, Gauss-Seidel) -> project -> advect (semi-Lagrangian, self-advection using the projected field) -> project. Fixed 20 GS iterations in both solves (stam2003 code). Backtrace clamped to [0.5, N+0.5].
boundary_conditions: set_bnd: walls reflect the normal velocity component (u=-u at x-walls, v=-v at y-walls) and copy the tangential one (free-slip, NOT no-slip)
Lid-driven cavity requires modifying set_bnd to impose u=U on the lid ghost layer (u_ghost = 2U - u_interior) and no-slip on the other walls; this is a modification, not in the paper
Periodic boundaries (stam1999 FFT variant) for Taylor-Green
methods.stability: Unconditionally stable for any dt (stam1999 abstract snippet): semi-Lagrangian interpolation is bounded (max principle) and implicit diffusion is unconditionally stable. Accuracy still requires CFL = |u| dt/h of order 1 or less; large dt adds strong numerical dissipation.
failure_modes: Numerical dissipation: first-order backtrace + bilinear interpolation damps vortices; Taylor-Green KE decays faster than exp(-4 nu k^2 t), especially at low nu
Incomplete projection with fixed 20 Gauss-Seidel sweeps -> residual divergence grows with N
Collocated central-difference projection has a checkerboard null space (odd-even decoupling)
Free-slip set_bnd gives wrong cavity results unless replaced by no-slip/lid BC
Steady-state cavity reached only slowly; quantitative Ghia match not claimed by the source
